references.purpose: Recommendations contribute to identity-bound Merit history.
Recommendations and trust are MeritCore semantics.
Trust does not substitute for authorization.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Recommendation author identity/relationship does not automatically grant MeritCore mutation authority. [2] Recommendation or trust score does not itself grant AccessCore authorization.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative feedback is retained as governed evidence and may initiate review.
semantics.ownership_rule: Recommendations and trust semantics belong to MeritCore, not PortfolioCore.
semantics.portfolio_rule: PortfolioCore may project/reference recommendations but does not own them.
semantics.project_rule: Recommendation may reference exact Project evidence where applicable.
semantics.recommendation_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Recommendation has explicit author identity, subject identity, context and evidence refs. [2] Recommendation identifies recommender, subject and relevant Project/context evidence.
semantics.trust_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Trust signals are explicit evidence/results rather than inferred from social proximity. [2] Trust is derived only by explicit MeritCore trust policy from eligible evidence.
